title: A waiver whose date has passed
Zones required that the pod count cannot reach
Skew impossible for the allowed count and zones
perNode cannot place the pods that must be scheduled
KRaft quorum cannot survive losing one zone
Even KRaft controller count
Broker setting admits only values Kafka refuses
With source brokers, a config key Kafka never returns
triggers:
kafka:
  source: brokers
  config:
    ssl.keystore.password: changeit
nearMiss:
kafka:
  source: brokers
  config:
    ssl.keystore.type: PKCS12

title: Replication factor above the most brokers the reference allows
min.insync.replicas not below the replication factor or broker count
Losing one zone drops partitions below min.insync.replicas
triggers:
brokers:
  zones: 2
kafka:
  config:
    default.replication.factor: 3
    min.insync.replicas: 2
nearMiss:
brokers:
  zones: 3
kafka:
  config:
    default.replication.factor: 3
    min.insync.replicas: 2

title: Reference requires unclean leader election
nearMiss:
brokers:
  count: 1
kafka:
  config:
    unclean.leader.election.enable: true

title: Request above its limit
Memory or storage size missing its unit
Single node on ephemeral storage
Strimzi 1.x with Kafka before 3.0
A required listener contradicts kafka.listeners.every
triggers:
kafka:
  listeners:
    require:
      - name: plain
        port: 9092
        tls: false
    every:
      tls: true
nearMiss:
kafka:
  listeners:
    require:
      - name: plain
        port: 9092
        auth: {oneOf: [tls, scram-sha-512]}
    every:
      auth: {oneOf: [scram-sha-512, oauth]}

title: A required listener's port is below Strimzi's minimum
triggers:
kafka:
  listeners:
    require:
      - name: ext
        type: route
        port: 443
        tls: true
nearMiss:
kafka:
  listeners:
    require:
      - name: ext
        type: route
        port: {min: 443, max: 9094}
        tls: true
